title.narrative: Strengthening Access to GCF: KOICA-GGGI Project Pipeline Development 2022-2024

description.narrative: This project is designed to support KOICA’s effort to contribute to poverty reduction and sustainable development in developing countries in the development of GCF project pipeline in cooperation with KOICA.The main outputs of this project will be 1)In-depth Sectoral Needs Assessment, 2)Workshop Report, and 3)two concept notes and its pre-feasiblity studies.Target county will be selected by KOICA in consultation with GGGI.
